milestone.description: Controlled SaaS integration for the existing AI observability platform: organization ownership, trusted identity, platform/tenant RBAC, lifecycle administration, licensing, audit, security and production evidence. Planning only; existing baseline issues retain ownership. Tests run locally or owner-run, never in GitHub Actions.

items.body:
Planning backlog only. Created after repository/backlog review on 2026-09-21. Unchecked criteria describe future delivery; this issue is not an implementation, test result or production approval.

## Objective

Integrate the new SaaS principal, lifecycle and ownership rules into existing business modules without rewriting them.

## Background

#5 already owns cross-store tenant enforcement, and many domain models/tests already use organization_id and negative tenant cases. #62/#63/#77 own workflow, artifact and retention foundations. This issue owns the SaaS-specific module rollout and legacy-data reconciliation, not rebuilding isolation or assuming current tests prove production coverage.

## Scope

Module-by-module SaaS context/state integration, approved ownership migration and regression verification; license integration only where a feature is explicitly license-controlled.

## Detailed Requirements

- Complete the architecture ownership inventory for projects/apps/environments, telemetry/traces/logs/metrics, LLM/agent/RAG records, sessions, evals/datasets/experiments, prompts, budgets/pricing, integrations, alerts/notifications, workforce/archive/access, ledger/finance, supervision/cases, views/reports and configuration.
- For each entity declare PLATFORM-SCOPED, ORGANIZATION-SCOPED, USER-SCOPED or GLOBAL. Preserve valid global catalogs and user-owned saved views with tenant constraints; trace end-user IDs and workforce subjects are not portal users. Direct organization_id is required only where justified; parent-derived ownership must remain provable.
- Extend repositories/services/APIs/queries and frontend data access to use authoritative single-org identity, resource ownership and organization status. Platform cross-org operations stay behind the distinct permission boundary, not generalized unscoped queries.
- Where missing, add reviewed org ownership columns, tenant-safe/composite foreign keys and indexes with expand/backfill/validate/contract migrations. Preserve IDs and history; quarantine ambiguous ownership, reconcile counts/hashes and prove rollback/restart recovery instead of mapping unknown rows to one organization.
- Reuse #5 PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and non-bypass app role, trusted ClickHouse query templates, server-derived VictoriaMetrics routes, tenant-bound S3 manifests/links and explicit Kafka/outbox/Temporal context. Propagate status/revocation checks through queues, async/thread bridges, exports, retries, cache keys and restore paths.
- Update shared client/filter/query-cache contracts so ordinary users cannot switch organization by changing URL/header/body or cached selector. Cancel incompatible requests and clear stale data after authority changes; enforce API checks independently.
- Require License Enforcement only for the modules/operations explicitly listed in the entitlement matrix. Non-license-controlled tenant integration proceeds in parallel; do not make later full administration UI or unrelated domain rewrites prerequisite to early data ownership.
- Preserve #95 purpose-limited content access, legal holds and #77 deletion/recovery semantics. Organization shutdown must not destroy retained evidence or grant broad platform data access.

## Dependencies

- [[SAAS] Implement Multi-Tenant Organization Foundation](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/170) (#170)
- [[SAAS] Implement SaaS-Aware Authentication Foundation](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/171) (#171)
- [[SAAS] Implement RBAC and Permission Framework](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/172) (#172)
- [[SAAS] Implement Organization Lifecycle Management](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/174) (#174)
- [[SAAS] Implement Organization Admin Management](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/175) (#175)
- [[SAAS] Implement Organization User Management](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/176) (#176)
- Conditional: [[SAAS] Implement License Enforcement and Usage Limits](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/178) (#178) - required only for explicitly license-controlled modules/features; nonlicensed tenant integration is not blocked.

Existing prerequisite contracts/deliveries (consume their evidence; do not reimplement):
- #5 - Implement tenant isolation middleware and data access enforcement

## Blocks

- [[SAAS] Implement Platform and Organization Dashboards](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/180) (#180)
- [[SAAS] Perform SaaS Security Hardening and Authorization Testing](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/182) (#182)
- [[SAAS] Complete SaaS Integration and Production Readiness](https://github.com/rameshsraj/ai-observability-platform/issues/183) (#183)

## Related Existing Issues

- #2 - Implement organization, project, application, and environment domain model and schema
- #3 - Implement authentication service: API keys, OIDC SSO, and service accounts
- #4 - Implement RBAC with roles, permissions, and resource-level access control
- #5 - Implement tenant isolation middleware and data access enforcement
- #7 - Implement OTLP/gRPC and HTTP trace ingestion endpoints
- #9 - Implement trace store schema and query layer in ClickHouse
- #10 - Implement metrics aggregation pipeline and time-series store
- #11 - Implement log ingestion and correlation with traces
- #36 - Implement dataset model, versioning, import/export, and trace-derived items
- #43 - Implement cost calculation engine and model pricing map
- #54 - Implement global filters, saved views, and drill-down navigation
- #62 - Implement durable evaluation orchestration with Temporal and idempotent result commits
- #63 - Implement tenant-scoped S3 artifact storage, retention, deletion and recovery
- #76 - Implement tenant-scoped security and administrative audit trail
- #77 - Implement cross-store retention, deletion and restore reconciliation
- #82 - Implement core integration contracts and secure connection lifecycle
- #87 - Implement workforce identity, directory sync and historical cost-center attribution
- #94 - Build auditable employee prompt and conversation archive with integrity and legal holds
- #95 - Enforce supervisor scope, purpose-limited prompt access and content-read auditing
- #96 - Implement authoritative AI usage ledger with token provenance and workforce attribution
- #97 - Reconcile AI invoices, subscriptions and credits with finance audit reports
- #100 - Build enterprise prompt usage and Intelligent Supervisor dashboard with audit drill-downs

## Implementation Tasks

- [ ] Publish an entity/module coverage matrix with baseline issue owner, actual enforcement path, migration delta and test evidence.
- [ ] Implement only uncovered SaaS integration/migration changes, using shared policy and store adapters.
- [ ] Reconcile legacy data and regression-check each affected API/UI/worker path before phased rollout.

## Security Considerations

- Test ownership before reads/counts/exports and writes; IDOR/BOLA and shared-cache leaks apply to all modules, not only administration.
- Absent context, stale permission, forged resource IDs and privileged database-role bypass must fail closed; employee content restrictions remain stricter than tenant membership.

## Testing Requirements

- Two-tenant/two-project tests must attempt foreign detail/list/search/count/update/delete/bulk/export/job/object/metric access, including reused connections after exceptions and async/thread transitions.
- Test fresh/legacy migration, concurrent writes during backfill, restart/replay, quarantine/reconciliation, legal holds and restore. Reuse existing negative tests and add uncovered SaaS regressions.
- Run real supported adapter integration profiles; SQLite or HTML fixtures alone cannot prove PostgreSQL RLS or cross-store production isolation.

Repository policy: all pytest, Vitest, Playwright, integration, security, visual and qualification tests run locally or in owner-run environments; attach evidence to PRs/issues. All lint, typecheck and builds also run in owner-run environments; no GitHub Actions. No tests are executed by this planning task.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every identified business entity has justified ownership and a traced SaaS integration/test path; no blind global schema change.
- [ ] Organization A users cannot access Organization B resources, counts, artifacts or queued results through any supported module.
- [ ] Existing functionality remains supported and legacy records have deterministic migrated ownership or explicit quarantine with remediation.
- [ ] Licensed modules include the enforcement prerequisite; nonlicensed module integration has no artificial licensing or UI dependency.

## Deliverables

- Ownership/module evidence matrix, reviewed incremental integrations/migrations, reconciliation/rollback report and cross-store regression results.

Delivery workflow: implement in dependency order on a branch, review/merge the PR, then keep the issue open and mark PENDING VERIFICATION with evidence and the existing Project status. Do not close issues. Existing source changes and existing issue ownership must be preserved.

## Out of Scope

- Whole-application rewrite, reimplementing #5/#62/#63/#77, new storage products, blanket tenant columns and blanket licensing of every feature.
